verdict.line: You lose if you facecheck a low-health Mundo and eat his missing-health AD spike from E (Masochism); you win if you bait his melee W (Burning Agony) into your W (Hallowed Mist) and burst him with Q's true damage before Adrenaline Rush can regen it back.

brief.thesis: Mundo's only ranged threat is Q (Infected Cleaver), a skillshot, and Gwen's W (Hallowed Mist) makes her untargetable to anything thrown from outside the mist, so once W is up at level 3 his poke tool is neutralized. From there Gwen's Q (Snip Snip!) deals true damage to the center target, which cuts straight through his passive (Adrenaline Rush) percent-health regen — the structural reason Gwen sits at 57.1% over 254 games here.

theirWindow.when: levels 1-2, before your W is up
theirWindow.what: Mundo's Q (Infected Cleaver) is a 975-range skillshot dealing damage based on your max health, on a 4s cooldown — stay behind minions and off cooldown-timing predictable angles until you hit level 3.

yourWindow.when: W is up and he walks into the mist
yourWindow.what: Hallowed Mist only lets enemies who enter it target you, so plant it on a minion wave and when Mundo steps in to use his melee-range W (Burning Agony), dash in with E (Skip 'n Slash) and chain Q snips — the true damage component ignores his passive regen.

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: 95% pick rate and 58.7% WR over 303 games — the extra potion buys you sustain through his early Cleaver pokes before your W comes online.

boots.why: 60.8% WR over 158 games — magic pen scales your Q true-damage trades and your on-hit E burst better than armor vs a matchup where his real threat is a dodgeable skillshot, not sustained auto damage.

core.why: First item on the 68.2% WR path over 66 games, builds your early burst spike into his sustain.
Second on the same path, adds magic pen and burst vs a target you're already true-damaging down.
Caps the highest-sample build path (68.2% WR) — by the time this finishes you should already be ahead from lane.

situational.when: he starts stacking regen or healing items and your true damage trades stop feeling decisive
the game goes long and you need your own sustain to keep all-inning a Sadism-buffed Mundo
you're snowballing and want the attack speed to chain E resets faster
his team adds heavy auto-attack damage and Sorcerer's Shoes stops paying off

runes.keystoneWhy: Extended trades are the norm against a regenerating target — Conqueror's ramping adaptive force and takedown healing reward you for staying in prolonged skirmishes rather than one burst and disengage.

summoners.why: Highest-run combo at 58.7% WR and 67.2% pick rate — Ignite converts your measured solo-kill advantage into actual kills by denying his Adrenaline Rush regen during all-ins.

playing.title: Hide behind minions pre-level 3
playing.detail: Before W is unlocked you have no answer to Q (Infected Cleaver), a 975-range skillshot — use the wave as cover rather than trading position for CS.

playing.title: Bait his W into your W
playing.detail: Burning Agony is melee range (325) and drains his own health to use — plant Hallowed Mist on the wave so he has to walk in to trade, at which point he's targetable and bleeding resource.

playing.title: Trade with Q's true damage, not raw magic damage
playing.detail: Snip Snip!'s true damage to the center target is what actually cuts through Adrenaline Rush — land the center hit in every trade instead of just clipping him with the cone edges.

playing.title: Don't tunnel a low-health Mundo
playing.detail: Masochism (E) gives him AD scaling with missing health on a 7s cooldown — a 'dying' Mundo can still out-trade a greedy auto-attack, so finish him with Q/E burst from range, not extra autos.

playing.title: Respect Sadism before committing deep
playing.detail: His R sacrifices health for movement speed and heavy regen — don't chase past your mist's edge expecting a kill right as he pops it.

playing.title: Chain E into Q to keep resetting your dash
playing.detail: Skip 'n Slash refunds part of its cooldown if you hit something during its attack-speed window — land an auto or Q immediately after the dash to keep the mobility loop alive.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, boots, runes, summoners and the 57.1%-over-254-games head-to-head are measured OP.GG data from the current patch; the mechanical reasoning behind each call — why the mist denies his poke, why true damage matters here — is my own read.
